# New York Film Academy (NYFA)

> > New York Film Academy's educational resources covering filmmaking, acting, animation, journalism, and game design for aspiring entertainment industry professionals.

NYFA provides comprehensive student resources spanning film production techniques, industry career guidance, and creative insights across multiple disciplines including animation, broadcast journalism, and game development. Content ranges from practical how-to guides on filmmaking and acting to cultural commentary on entertainment media.

## Key Topics

- Film Production & Filmmaking
- Acting & Performance
- Animation & Storyboarding
- Broadcast Journalism
- Producing & Film Rights
- Game Development
- Adobe Photoshop & Design Tools
- Hollywood & Entertainment Industry
- Film Promotion & Marketing
- Project Ownership & Intellectual Property
- Industry Career Guidance
- Journalism Ethics & Native Advertising
- Steven Spielberg & Notable Directors

## Film & Video Production Resources

- [How To Make Movie Posters To Promote Your Film](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/make-movie-posters-promote-film): Film poster design guide using Adobe Photoshop and promotion tips
- [How Can I Own My Producing Project?](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/how-can-i-own-my-producing-project): Producer Neal Weisman explains project ownership and option agreements
- [Interview With Paquita Hughes: Applying a 'Military Mind' To The Film Industry](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/interview-paquita-hughes-applying-a-military-mind-to-the-film-industry): Navy veteran Paquita Hughes on transitioning from military to filmmaking

## Acting & Performance

- [13 Tips On Surviving In The Acting Industry](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/13-tips-on-surviving-in-the-acting-industry): Acting career survival guide by Lynda Goodfriend for Hollywood actors
- [How To Submit To An Audition Notice Via Email](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/how-to-submit-to-an-audition-notice-via-email): Audition email submission guide by Glynis Rigsby for actors

## Animation & Illustration

- [Review Of New York Film Academy's Animation BFA](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/review-new-york-film-academy-animation-bfa): Animation BFA program overview by Mark Sawicki covering 3D and design
- [Storyboarding For Animation: Q&A With NYFA Instructor Tim Fielder](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/storyboarding-for-animation-qa): Animation storyboard techniques Q&A with instructor Tim Fielder
- [5 Of The Most Influential And Famous Illustrators of ALL Time](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/5-of-the-most-influential-and-famous-illustrators-of-all-time): Famous illustrators including Charles Schultz and Bill Watterson

## Broadcast Journalism & Media

- [Writing For Broadcast Journalism](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/writing-broadcast-journalism): Broadcast writing techniques and journalism skills for digital age
- [The Ten Commandments of Native Advertising For Journalists](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/ten-commandments-of-native-advertising): Journalism ethics guide for native advertising and sponsored content
- [Most Shockingly Memorable Moments in News Journalism History](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/shockingly-memorable-moments-news-journalism-history): Historic broadcast journalism moments featuring John Stossel incident

## Film & Entertainment Culture

- [Sam Peckinpah](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/sam-peckinpah): Director profile of Sam Peckinpah and The Wild Bunch legacy
- [Mother's Day: Mothers in Film We Can't Help But Love](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/mothers-day-2017-mothers-in-film-we-cant-help-but-love): Mother's Day film roundup featuring Fresh off the Boat's Jessica Huang
- [7 Perfect Films for Father's Day](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/7-perfect-films-for-fathers-day): Father's Day film list featuring Disney's Pinocchio and Geppetto
- [Films for The Holidays: Classics, Action, and Horror, Oh My!](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/films-for-the-holidays-classics-action-and-horror-oh-my): Holiday film recommendations including Die Hard and Bruce Willis classics
- [5 Popular Olympic Movies](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/5-popular-olympic-movies): Olympic sports films including Cool Runnings and athlete stories

## Game Development & Interactive Media

- [Why Other Game Development Companies Should Copy "Nintendo Direct"](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/game-development-companies-should-copy-nintendo-direct): Nintendo Direct marketing strategy analysis for E3 presentations
- [Pokémon Brilliant Diamond & Shining Pearl: Repackaged And Resold or Satisfying Update To The Originals?](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/pokemon-brilliant-diamond-shining-pearl-repackaged-and-resold-or-satisfying-update-to-the-originals): Nintendo Switch Pokémon remake analysis comparing to Sinnoh originals
- [April Fools' Joke, or is Kojima Set to Leave Konami?](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/april-fools-joke-kojima-set-leave-konami): Gaming industry news on Hideo Kojima's departure from Konami
- [Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins, Taking Reboots in Stride](https://www.nyfa.edu/student-resources/snake-eyes-g-i-joe-origins-taking-reboots-in-stride): G.I. Joe franchise reboot analysis of Snake Eyes origin story
